title: anthriscus alpina
intro: Anthriscus alpina, commonly known as Alpine Chervil or Mountain Parsley, is a perennial plant belonging to the carrot family, Apiaceae. The leaves and seeds of Anthriscus alpina have been used in traditional medicine for their health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for treating a range of conditions, from respiratory issues to skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Anthriscus alpina include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
